UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile with personal information and preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

primaryGoal.description: User's primary fitness goal (e.g., muscle definition, fat loss).

weeklyTrainingFrequency.description: Number of times the user trains per week.

WorkoutRoutine.title: WorkoutRoutine
WorkoutRoutine.description: Represents a workout routine created by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutRoutine entity.

type.description: Type of workout routine (e.g., strength, bio-dynamics, TRX).

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for which the workout routine is scheduled.

Exercise.title: Exercise
Exercise.description: Represents a single exercise within a workout routine.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Exercise entity.

description.description: Description of how to perform the exercise.

videoUrl.description: URL of a video demonstrating the exercise.

exerciseType.description: The kind of exercise (e.g., strength, mobility, static).

WorkoutExercise.title: WorkoutExercise
WorkoutExercise.description: Represents the relationship between a workout routine and an exercise, including sets and reps.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkoutExercise entity.

sets.description: Number of sets for the exercise.

reps.description: Number of repetitions for each set.

Habit.title: Habit
Habit.description: Represents a habit that the user wants to track.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Habit entity.

programName.description: The name of the program that the habit is associated with.

lessons.description: The number of lessons the habit requires.

HabitCompletion.title: HabitCompletion
HabitCompletion.description: Represents the completion status of a habit for a specific date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HabitCompletion entity.

completionDate.description: Date on which the habit was completed.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the habit was completed on the given date.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support Zenith Trainer's core features, focusing on user-specific data and collaborative elements while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling.  The structure prioritizes path-based ownership for user-generated content and employs denormalization where needed to avoid hierarchical authorization dependencies.  All `list` operations will be secure, ensuring that rules are not filters (QAPs).  

*   **User Profiles:** User profiles are stored in a private collection using path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/profile`). This ensures that only the authenticated user can access their profile data.
*   **Workout Routines and Exercises:** Workout routines and exercises are nested under the user's profile (`/users/{userId}/workoutRoutines/{workoutRoutineId}` and `/users/{userId}/workoutRoutines/{workoutRoutineId}/workoutExercises/{workoutExerciseId}`). This structure continues the hierarchical path-based ownership model. The `Exercise` entity itself lives as a global entity so that users can reference it and re-organize it within their workout routines.
*   **Habit Tracking:** Habits and habit completion records are stored under the user's profile, again using path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}` and `/users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}/habitCompletions/{habitCompletionId}`).

**Authorization Independence & QAPs:**

Authorization independence is achieved through path-based ownership and avoiding `get()` calls in security rules.  Since all workout routines, exercises, habits, and habit completions are stored under the user's profile, security rules can simply check if `request.auth.uid == userId` to grant access. This eliminates the need to fetch parent documents to determine authorization.

The data structure will support QAPs as all `list` operations will be scoped to the user's data via the path-based ownership. Rules will not act as filters, as unauthorized documents will not be accessible in the first place.
